clue.text: Assume importing gold will be strange

indicators.note: to import is to bring something in, so the word for assume takes the gold symbol inside it

parts.note: to feign is to assume a manner or appearance falsely
OR is the heraldic word for gold

explanation.surface: Taking on a borrowed manner that includes gold will look odd.
explanation.definitionFit: Something foreign is alien or unfamiliar, hence strange.

clue.text: Relax, unusually, in the morning after old test

indicators.note: after places the rearranged letters following the abbreviation for old
unusually means in an odd way, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: AM, ante meridiem, means in the morning

explanation.surface: Advice to unwind, oddly, in the morning following an old exam.
explanation.definitionFit: A viva voce or spoken examination is a test given by mouth.

clue.text: Stay up with Her Majesty after party for criminal

indicators.note: after places the royal letters behind the party
in a down clue up means read from bottom to top, so the word for stay is turned round

parts.note: to live somewhere is to stay or reside there
a do is a party
ER, Elizabeth Regina, is the cipher of the late Queen

explanation.surface: Staying up with the Queen after a party, then labelled a criminal.
explanation.definitionFit: A wrongdoer, someone who commits wicked or criminal acts.

clue.text: A bishop must wear new designer coats

indicators.note: to wear is to have on the outside, so the rearranged letters go around the inner piece
new means remade, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: B is the chess notation for bishop

explanation.surface: A bishop forced into vestments from a new couturier.
explanation.walkthrough: 'new' turns DESIGNER into GERDINES, which 'must wear' AB inside, after the G.
explanation.definitionFit: Gabardines are long raincoats made of a tightly woven twill fabric.

clue.text: Eager to promote new joint

indicators.note: to promote is to move upward, and in a down clue the letter for new rises higher in the word

parts.note: keen means eager

explanation.surface: Keen to advance a new partnership.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to promote' lifts the N of KEEN two places up.
explanation.definitionFit: The knee is the joint between thigh and lower leg.

clue.text: Job that is for a delivery worker

parts.note: a post is a job or position
i.e., id est, means that is

explanation.surface: A job description for someone in deliveries.
explanation.definitionFit: British informal word for the person who delivers the mail.

clue.text: Church song popular trio played on time

indicators.note: on places the next piece after, beneath in a down entry

parts.note: in means fashionable or popular

indicators.note: played suggests a piece performed freely, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A popular trio performs a hymn in time.
explanation.definitionFit: An introit is a psalm or antiphon sung as the priest approaches the altar.

clue.text: One word for dragon, in two words!

definitions.text: One word for dragon, in two words!

parts.words: One word for dragon, in two words!
parts.note: split as two words it reads drag on, which means to go on and on; as one word it means to keep going

explanation.surface: A riddle about a fire-breathing beast.
explanation.walkthrough: 'dragon' looks like the monster, but split into DRAG ON it means continuing tediously, which the answer means as one word.
explanation.definitionFit: To persist is to carry on stubbornly, to drag on.

clue.text: Reveal a new grammatical term for an object in front of church

indicators.note: these words place the earlier pieces ahead of the church abbreviation

parts.note: in grammar a noun is the word naming a thing or object
CE stands for the Church of England

explanation.surface: A grammar lesson revealing a fresh word for a thing, set before a church.
explanation.definitionFit: To announce something is to make it public, to reveal it.

clue.text: Girl from musical pocketing doctor's instrument

indicators.note: pocketing means taking something inside, so the girl's name holds the doctor's letters

parts.note: Maria is the heroine of The Sound of Music and of West Side Story
MB, Bachelor of Medicine, is a doctor's qualification

explanation.surface: A musical heroine slips off with a doctor's instrument.
explanation.definitionFit: A marimba is a wooden percussion instrument like a large xylophone.

clue.text: Gives prominence to characteristics

definitions.meaning: a magazine that highlights a story spotlights it
distinctive traits or attributes of something

explanation.surface: A double definition: one verb sense, one noun sense.
explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means showcases; as a plural noun it means distinctive traits.

clue.text: Developed register of timeless fakes

indicators.note: developed means worked into a new form, so these letters are rearranged
timeless means without time, so its abbreviation T is dropped

explanation.surface: A doctored record of undated counterfeits.
explanation.walkthrough: 'timeless' takes T out of REGISTER OF, and 'Developed' rearranges the rest.
explanation.definitionFit: Forgeries are counterfeit copies, passed off as genuine.

clue.text: The French article and the German article?

parts.note: le is the French masculine word for the
a is the indefinite article in English
der is the German masculine word for the

explanation.surface: A grammar question about articles in French and German.
explanation.walkthrough: The final 'article' looks like more grammar, but it is a newspaper article; the first 'article' alone gives A.
explanation.definitionFit: A leader is a newspaper's leading editorial piece setting out its opinion.

clue.text: Rash types adviser led off

indicators.note: off here means gone wrong or out of order, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Reckless people led a counsellor astray.
explanation.walkthrough: 'off' turns ADVISER LED into the answer.
explanation.definitionFit: Daredevils are reckless people who take foolish risks.

clue.text: Upset married model after dance

indicators.note: after places the married and model pieces behind the dance

parts.note: a disco is a dance
to pose is to model, as for an artist

explanation.surface: A married model is upset after the dance.
explanation.definitionFit: To discompose someone is to agitate or disturb them.

clue.text: Simple canal boat with no end of painting

indicators.note: with no means lacking, so the boat word drops a letter

parts.note: a barge is a flat-bottomed canal boat

indicators.note: end of picks the final letter of painting

explanation.surface: A plain narrowboat left with its painting unfinished.
explanation.walkthrough: 'end of painting' is G, and 'with no' removes it from BARGE.
explanation.definitionFit: Bare means plain or unadorned, i.e. simple.

clue.text: Manage stewed prunes for some on the podium

parts.note: to run something is to manage it

indicators.note: stewed fruit is cooked down and jumbled, so these letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: An instruction to cook prunes for the medal winners.
explanation.definitionFit: Those finishing second and third stand on the lower steps of the podium, beside the winner.

clue.text: Mournful chap supporting scheme

indicators.note: in a down clue the supporting piece sits underneath, so it comes second

parts.note: a plan is a scheme
gent is short for gentleman, a chap

explanation.surface: A sad man backing a plan.
explanation.definitionFit: Plangent describes a loud, resonant and melancholy sound.

clue.text: Poisonous type in house south of London

parts.note: Scorpio is one of the twelve astrological houses of the zodiac

indicators.note: the southern end of a word in a down entry is its bottom, its final letter

explanation.surface: A venomous creature found in a home beyond the capital's southern edge.
explanation.walkthrough: 'house' is a zodiac sign, not a building.
explanation.definitionFit: A scorpion is an arachnid with a venomous sting.

clue.text: Cheaper time to go on holiday with dog, some say

parts.note: to be off is to be away on leave

indicators.note: some say means as heard, so the dog's name gives a word of the same sound

parts.note: a Peke is a Pekingese dog

explanation.surface: Travelling with the dog when fares are lower.
explanation.definitionFit: Off-peak periods are quieter times when fares and charges are lower.

clue.text: Pressure on recount for bishop, perhaps

parts.note: P is the physics symbol for pressure
to relate a story is to recount it

explanation.surface: Pressure for a fresh count to choose a bishop.
explanation.definitionFit: A senior churchman such as a bishop is an example of a high-ranking cleric.

clue.text: Want to have one for a defeat

indicators.note: to have one for a means the word gets one in place of the letter a
for means instead of, signalling the swap of one letter for another

parts.note: want means lack, as in a want of money
I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Wanting one ahead of a loss.
explanation.walkthrough: 'to have' and 'for' replace the A of LACK with I.
explanation.definitionFit: To lick an opponent is informally to beat them soundly.

clue.text: I'm sort of upset about one's instruction for player

indicators.note: about means surrounding, so the rearranged letters go around the next piece
upset means knocked over and disordered, so these letters are rearranged

parts.note: one's read as one is gives I plus S

explanation.surface: Someone confesses to being somewhat distressed over a musician's directions.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' turns I'M SORT OF into FORTSIMO, which goes 'about' IS (one is).
explanation.definitionFit: This musical direction tells a performer to play very loudly.

clue.text: Keen on Geordie chant?

parts.note: to be into something is to be keen on it
a Geordie is from Newcastle in the North East of England, abbreviated NE

explanation.surface: Is a Newcastle native keen on a football chant?
explanation.definitionFit: To intone is to recite or chant in a level voice.

clue.text: Slogan adopted by human traffickers?

indicators.note: adopted by means taken in by, so the word sits within these clue words

explanation.surface: A catchphrase used by people smugglers.
explanation.definitionFit: A mantra is a phrase repeated constantly, like a motto or catchword.

clue.text: Career of mostly courteous Independent and Conservative ministers at the end

indicators.note: mostly means not quite all, so the synonym loses its final letter

parts.note: polite means courteous
I is the abbreviation for an Independent politician

indicators.note: at the end picks the last letter of ministers

explanation.surface: An independent, civil Tory MP's working life, with ministers at its close.
explanation.definitionFit: Politics is a profession that people follow as a career.

clue.text: Ready when cutting into central heating

indicators.note: cutting into means going inside, so the word for when sits within the heating letters

parts.note: as means when, as in as I left

explanation.surface: Prepared for when the heating gets cut.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Ready' is money, as in ready cash, not prepared.
explanation.definitionFit: Readies or ready money is informal for available money.

clue.text: Controversial speech from European male in charge

parts.note: a Pole is a European from Poland

explanation.surface: A Polish man in charge delivering a fiery address.
explanation.definitionFit: A polemic is a strongly argued attack, a contentious piece of rhetoric.

clue.text: Last on, is hoping to contain surprise

indicators.note: to contain means to hold within, so the word is held within these clue words

explanation.surface: The final act is hoping for a surprise.
explanation.definitionFit: To astonish someone is to amaze them, to take them by surprise.

clue.text: Refuse to accept it's rejected fate

indicators.note: to accept means to take in, so the refusal word takes the turned letters inside

parts.note: to deny is to refuse

indicators.note: rejected means sent back, so the letters of it's run backwards

explanation.surface: A defiant refusal to accept one's lot.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rejected' turns ITS into STI, which DENY takes in.
explanation.definitionFit: Destiny is the predetermined course of events, one's fate.
